architecture.mechanism: Erosion-corrosion of condenser tubes caused by high-velocity water jet impingement and vibrating foreign wire-like bodies removing the protective copper oxide film
architecture.intervention: Install a **dual-layer filtration system** with a **magnetic separator** upstream of the condenser tubes to remove suspended metallic debris (e.g., wire fragments) and a **vortex flow inducer** inside the tubes to disrupt high-velocity jet formation while maintaining flow velocity below the erosion threshold (~1.5 m/s for copper alloys)
architecture.expected_effect: Reduction of erosion-corrosion damage to condenser tubes, preserving the protective copper oxide layer, thereby minimizing fouling-related condensing temperature rise and restoring plant capacity to within 2% of baseline at peak load
architecture.falsification_test: Post-implementation inspection of 10% of condenser tubes via **borescope** after 12 months of operation should show <5% surface area with exposed copper (no oxide film) and <1 metallic foreign body per 100m of tubing, compared to pre-intervention baseline
